requirements.text: The color chooser requires the presence of a hardware pointing device.
The color translator requires the presence of the software color search module.
The closest colors tool requires the presence of the software color search module.
The color search engine requires the color space and paint information databases to be present.
The User Color Palette requires the color search engine for color requests and the color sample matcher to enable the storing of uploaded images for matching.
The application administrative interface requires the color space and paint information databases to be present.
The color sample matcher requires the color search engine module to function.
The color chooser requires the presence of a hardware pointing device.
Implement security controls in accordance with OWASP Top 10 guidelines for web applications, including secure session management and input validation.
Enforce multi-factor authentication for all administrative accounts and implement role-based access control (RBAC) with audit logging for all administrative actions.
All user-specific data, including color palettes and uploaded images, must be encrypted at rest and protected against unauthorized access via session-bound authorization.
Define specific security standards (e.g., 'Administrative access must be protected by TLS 1.2+ and password hashing using Argon2 or bcrypt').
Specify the automated process for data purging (e.g., 'A daily cron job shall delete user session data older than 30 days').
Define the recovery strategy (e.g., 'The system shall implement a circuit breaker pattern and log all exceptions to a centralized monitoring service without exposing stack traces to the user').
Define the expected concurrent user load and the maximum latency under that load.
Define the maximum number of concurrent users the system must support to ensure the server hardware specifications are adequate for the expected load.
Specify the performance target as: 'The system shall process color search queries in under 1 second at the 95th percentile under a load of X concurrent users.'
Replace 'Real-time' with a concrete latency requirement for administrative updates (e.g., 'Administrative updates shall be reflected in the system within 5 seconds').
